# Deel

> Deel is a global HR and payroll platform enabling companies to hire, pay, and manage teams compliantly across 150+ countries.

Deel provides an integrated suite of solutions including global payroll, HRIS, benefits administration, talent acquisition, and employee mobility management. The platform serves enterprises and scaling companies that need to navigate complex international compliance requirements while managing distributed workforces.

## Key Topics

- Global Payroll
- HRIS
- Compliance Management
- Multi-Country Payroll
- EOR (Employer of Record)
- PEO (Professional Employer Organization)
- International Hiring
- Contractor Management
- Employee Benefits
- Payroll Engine
- Workforce Management
- Employee Mobility
- HR Platform
- Compliance Automation
- Global HR

## Core Platform & Solutions

- [Deel | Global Payroll, Compliance, HR Solutions | HRIS](https://www.deel.com): Deel's homepage showcasing global payroll, compliance, and HR platform across 150+ countries
- [HR Software to Manage Payroll, Compliance & More | Deel](https://www.deel.com/solutions/hr): Deel HR software for payroll, compliance, onboarding, and employee engagement
- [Payroll Solutions | Hire & Pay in 130+ Countries | Deel](https://www.deel.com/solutions/payroll): Deel's global payroll solution for accurate, compliant payments in 130+ countries
- [Find & Hire Employees Around The World | Deel Hire](https://www.deel.com/solutions/hire): Deel Hire for global talent acquisition, EOR, and contractor management
- [Improve Employee Benefits in 100+ Countries | Deel Benefits](https://www.deel.com/solutions/benefits): Deel Benefits platform for multi-country benefits administration and enrollment
- [Payroll Engine | Powering Payroll in 50+ Countries | Deel](https://www.deel.com/solutions/payroll-engine): Deel's Payroll Engine powering real-time calculations across 50+ countries
- [Fast global HR answers and insights with AI | Deel](https://www.deel.com/hr-platform/ai): Deel AI assistant for HR insights, compliance answers, and workforce analytics

## Specialized Solutions

- [Employee Mobility Software & Solutions | Deel Mobility](https://www.deel.com/solutions/mobility): Deel Mobility for visa tracking and work authorization in 100+ countries
- [IT Management Software & Solutions for Remote Teams | Deel](https://www.deel.com/solutions/it): IT management solution for device lifecycle and access control across 130+ countries
- [Payroll in 150+ Countries | Global Payroll with Deel](https://www.deel.com/use-cases/run-global-payroll): Use case page for consolidated global payroll across employees and contractors
